digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration — first-class Bedrock support
propositions: Rebar must support AWS Bedrock as a first-class provider without requiring an OpenAI-compatible gateway, enabling native prompt caching and structured output

Prompt caching on Bedrock silently fails for certain model IDs (e.g., opus-4-5) while billing full input tokens; rebar must warn when cache_read and cache_write counters are both zero despite caching being requested

Some Bedrock model IDs reject temperature parameters with 400 ValidationException; rebar must withdraw temperature when unsupported rather than hard-failing, and provide actionable error messages naming the model ID and remedies

The Bedrock provider builder must authenticate via ambient AWS credential chain (instance role or AWS_PROFILE) without rebar-managed keys, and construct BedrockConverseModel with exactly two cache keys matching direct-Anthropic parity (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions, not bedrock_cache_messages)
Bedrock builder and cache-zero warning are blocked on runner.py shrinkage task 2682 because runner.py is at the 800-LOC hard cap and adding both additions requires freeing headroom
Optional [bedrock] extra must be added to dev extra so unit tests run in CI without boto3 in default [agents] install, keeping AWS dependency opt-in
